strI, (makarayuktA pOrRamAsyatreti । makara + aR + NIz .) mAGaSuklasaptamI । atra snAnAdiviDiryaTA । Bavizye । “sUryyagrahaRatulyA hi SuklA mAGasya saptamI । aruRodayavelAyAM tasyAM snAnaM mahAPalam ॥ mAGe mAsi site pakze saptamI kowiBAskarA । dadyAt snAnArDyadAnAByAmAyurArogyasampadaH ॥ aruRodayavelAyAM SuklA mAGasya saptamI । gaNgAyAM yadi laByeta sUryyagrahaSatEH samAH ॥” kowiBAskarA kowisaptamItulyA saptamyA BAskaradevatAkatvAt । sUryyagrahaRaPalaM snAnajam । sannihite budDirantaraNgetinyAyAt । tena bahuSatasUryyagrahaRakAlInagaNgAsnAnajanyaPalasamaPalamatra jYeyam ॥ * ॥ snAnaparipAwI mAha kftyakalpalatAyAM vizRuH । saptavadarapatrARi saptArkapatrARi ca Sirasi niDAya, -- “o~ yadyajjanmakftaM pApaM mayA saptasu janmasu । tanme rokaYca SokaYca mAkarI hantu saptamI ॥” ityuccAryya snAyAditi SezaH । rokaM Cidram । tiTikftyasya pOrRamAsyantamAsANgatvAt mAkarIpadaM makarArkArabDacAndramAsIyatiTiparam । tiTikftye ca kfzRAdiM vrate SuklAdimeva ca । vivAhAdO ca sOrAdiM mAsaM kftye vinirddiSediti brahmapurARAt manvantarAditvena taTA yuktatvAcca । yaTA, matsyapurARam । “yasmAnmanvantarAdO tu raTamApurdivAkarAH । mAGamAsasya saptamyAM tasmAt sA raTasaptamI ॥ aruRodayavelAyAM tasyAM snAnaM mahAPalam .” ataeva nArasiMhe raTAKyAyAmityuktam ॥ * ॥ arGyadAnaparipAwI yaTA, -- “arkapatrEH savadarErddUrvvAkzatasacandanEH । azwANgaviDinAcAryyaM dadyAdAdityatuzwaye । azwANgamarDyamApUryya BAnormUrdDni nivedayet ॥ arGyamantrastu । jananI sarvvaBUtAnAM saptamI saptasaptike । saptavyAhftike devi namaste ravimaRqale ॥ praRAmamantrastu । saptasaptivaha prIta saptalokapradIpana । saptamyAYca namastuByaM namo'nantAya veDase ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ * ॥ tasyAM sUryyamuddiSya raTayAtrAPalaM yaTA, -- “mAGamAsasya saptamyAM devaM SAmbapuraM narAH । raTayAtrAM prakurvvanti sarvvadvandvavivarjitAH ॥ gacCanti tatpadaM SAntaM sUryyamaRqalaBedakam । etatte kaTitaM devi ! sAmbaSApasamudBavam । pApapraSamanAKyAnaM mahApAtakanASanam ॥” iti varAhapurARam ॥
